info.name: Daily Meat - Backend API (Handover Collection)
info.description: Comprehensive Postman API collection for Daily Meat Node.js + Express + PostgreSQL backend. Includes all Customer, Driver, and Admin endpoints with pre-configured Bearer tokens, environment variables, and auto-token test scripts.

request.description: Check if the Express API server is awake and accepting HTTP connections.
Returns server uptime, status, and database connectivity health.
Determines whether phone exists and returns role (CUSTOMER, DRIVER, ADMIN). Used on frontend to route between OTP or password.
Dispatches 6-digit OTP via SMS Fortius (DLT template) or Zoho SMTP email. Note: '9000000000' is a pre-configured test account that always uses OTP '123456'.
Regenerates and re-transmits an OTP.

exec: console.log('Saved authToken & refreshToken to Collection Variables');

request.description: Verifies 6-digit OTP. Returns User object and JWT access + refresh tokens. Test script automatically captures authToken into Postman collection variables!

exec: console.log('Saved staff auth token to Collection Variables');

request.description: Bcrypt password authentication for Store Staff (Admin & Delivery Drivers).
Exchanges valid refresh token for brand new access token.
Returns profile details, push token status, and notification preferences.
Updates user's name, email, and marks `is_profile_completed = true`.
Updates bcrypt password for staff members.
Registers Expo or FCM push token for order tracking & promotion notifications.
Dispatches a live test push alert to the logged-in user's device.
Revokes refresh token in database and unbinds device push token.
Anonymizes user PII, removes addresses and coupon links while keeping financial ledger consistency.
List all addresses saved by the logged-in customer.
Validates delivery area and calculates Haversine distance from shop.
Public endpoint returning store coordinates, service radius, store timings, and deliverable pincodes.
Fetches Chicken, Mutton, Fish, Eggs, Combos, etc.
Returns active products with their cut variants, gross/net weights, and prices.
App home sliders and promotional graphics.

request.description: Creates an order inside a strict database transaction. If paymentMethod is ONLINE, initializes Cashfree session ID.
Lists past orders, line items, status progression, and assigned driver.
Cancels order. If paid online, automatically calls Cashfree API to trigger instant refund.
Deletes an abandoned draft order if online checkout was cancelled before payment.
Lists active coupons eligible for the user based on redemptions & audience rules.
Evaluates coupon rules (min order, max discount cap, usage limits) and returns calculated savings.
Called by Mobile App SDK immediately after Cashfree drop-in UI finishes. Validates signature with Cashfree server.
Public webhook receiver for Cashfree asynchronous payment confirmations.
Fetches ASSIGNED, PICKED, and OUT_FOR_DELIVERY orders assigned to this driver.
Returns today's deliveries count and 7-day performance graph data.
Triggers push notification to customer and notifies admin room.
Marks delivery complete. If paymentMethod is COD, automatically updates payment_status to PAID.
